response.original_title: Del otro lado de la red
response.overview: After moving from Montevideo to Barcelona, Maximiliano Martínez hears his father say "I love you" for the first time in 30 years. Filming him over time, he uncovers traces of domestic violence and confronts silence, fear, and inherited wounds. Through tennis, father and son search for a new way to connect.
